svg.title: Basina coverage and expansion — Iran today, Persian Gulf and West Asia next
svg.desc: Online care available across Iran, with an in-person doctor network in Hormozgan, Fars, Kerman, Isfahan, Bushehr and Khuzestan. Basina is expanding multilingual telehealth to the Persian Gulf, West Asia, and Arabic- and English-speaking users.
svg.text: Online across Iran today — in-person in six provinces, expanding to the region.
Same platform. Same record. New borders.
همان پلتفرم، همان پرونده، مرزهای تازه
International availability, languages, and payment options are being rolled out progressively.
